exposure: exercise intervention based on self-efficacy theory
cohort: The study included 103 pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus, randomized into an intervention group (53) and a control group (50).
finding: An exercise intervention based on self-efficacy theory significantly improved exercise self-efficacy and compliance, effectively controlled blood glucose and weight gain, and reduced the incidence of neonatal hypoglycemia and gestational hypertension in pregnant women with GDM.
